summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new admin-only 'Purchase List' and 'Goods to Arrive' feature. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (RBAC, snapshot maths, per-item state, temp/refresh, season, purview, fixed baseline, config, goods-order lifecycle, 404). Frontend (admin/admin123): sidebar order Dashboard->Purchase List->Goods to Arrive correct, list renders (297 rows), default sort Profit Ag desc, item_name & order_qty sorts work, green checkbox marks row + auto-creates a matching goods order, left-swipe (mouse drag) temp-removes row, Refresh restores swiped rows but preserves green marks and does not undo seasonal removal, item dialog toggles seasons/purview/baseline, adding a salesman via + adds chip at top and re-filters correctly, fixed baseline of 8 produced order_qty exactly 8 - current_stock (7.867 for NAJARIYA PLAIN 92.5), qty edit in Goods to Arrive recomputes fine/labour, Mark Arrived + Undo move between tabs, past-date picker (2 weeks ago) loads its snapshot. Dashboard and Sales Report regression pages both load without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PurchaseList.jsx SwipeRow: pointerdown drag state is not cancelled on window blur / pointercancel - a mid-drag focus loss can leave the drag armed and misinterpret a later click as a swipe. Consider adding a pointercancel handler.

server.py update_purchase_item_state: passing an empty string for fixed_baseline_kg silently sets it to None; a small validation error for negative values would help (currently negative floats are accepted).
seed_data_creation: Added purchase orderers TEST_ORDR_QA and SURESH_QA2 via API (persisted). All per-item state (green marks, temp_removed, seasons, purview, baseline_mode) was reset for touched items (NAJARIYA PLAIN 92.5, GHUNTI KP-120) at the end of testing. Two orderer chips remain in the purchase_orderers collection for future admin tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_purchase_list_feature.py (14 tests, ~11s). Left-swipe UI works via Playwright's mouse.down/move/up. Toast notifications from Sonner can intercept clicks on the Goods to Arrive tab-pending trigger immediately after arriving/undo; wait ~4s or use force=True. purchase_orderers now contains RAJESH, TEST_ORDR_QA, SURESH_QA2 in addition to Admin.
